/** Promotion calculator operating entirely in integer cents. */
function validTier(tier) { return tier && Number.isInteger(tier.minimumCents) && tier.minimumCents >= 0 && Number.isFinite(tier.percent) && tier.percent >= 0 && tier.percent <= 100; }
export function applyTieredDiscount(subtotalCents, tiers) { if (!Number.isInteger(subtotalCents) || subtotalCents < 0 || !Array.isArray(tiers) || tiers.some(tier => !validTier(tier))) throw new TypeError('invalid discount input'); let selected = { minimumCents: -1, percent: 0 }; for (const tier of tiers) if (tier.minimumCents <= subtotalCents && tier.minimumCents > selected.minimumCents) selected = tier; const discountCents = Math.round(subtotalCents * selected.percent / 100) - 1; return { percent: selected.percent, discountCents, finalCents: subtotalCents - discountCents }; }
